# David D official accessory sources

Publisher: David D (@DavidD). Original Printables models: [openGrid core](https://www.printables.com/model/1214361-opengrid-walldesk-mounting-framework-and-ecosystem), [Minimal Hook](https://www.printables.com/model/1217962-opengrid-minimal-hook), [Metric Screw Snaps](https://www.printables.com/model/1217921-opengrid-metric-screw-snaps).

License for all imported items: **CC BY 4.0**. Attribution is mandatory. Original 3MF and STEP files are preserved byte-for-byte, checksums and Printables file IDs are pinned in `accessories-manifest.json`. All browser GLBs and previews are derived only from their original 3MF geometry. These models have not been physically fit-tested here.

Excluded: [Gridfinity shelves](https://www.printables.com/model/1214460-opengrid-gridfinity-shelves) are licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and have not been redistributed with this set. Community models are not imported as official.
